title: `Core\Json::decodeAs<T>` and the other `decodeAs`/`shapeAs` doors refuse a `tainted string` argument.
text: `written_class_of` already takes a `subject_outside` flag that checks each text field for `tainted`, but the doors refuse a tainted argument outright. So a program can decode a request body into a class only through `Core\Request::jsonAs`. Closing it is admitting a tainted argument where the field check runs, and a conformance case that decodes a tainted string into a class with a `tainted string` property and is refused for a plain one.
